seoDescription: Datixxia™ turns daily public and private procurement data from 194 countries into real-time business intelligence and 4-year forecasts.

hero.title: Datixxia™ market intelligence and 4-year forecasts
hero.lead: Datixxia™ is a market intelligence platform that turns daily public and private procurement data into real-time business intelligence and 4-year forecasts for every market sector.

features.label: Features
features.subtitle: The essential tools for reading the world's procurement data

items.label: Calculate value
items.text: Datixxia™ delivers past and current valuations and forecasts any market sector’s value up to 4 years in advance.

items.label: Empirical forecasts
items.text: The platform provides micro-economic—not macro-economic—forecasts based on future-valid data rather than conjecture.

items.label: Economic visibility
items.text: Our model gives financial and economic visibility to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

items.label: Universal
items.text: Datixxia™ can be used by any business in the world, from banks to bakers.

why.label: Why Datixxia™
why.lead: Datixxia™ is a groundbreaking economic forecasting system. It accurately calculates the past, present, and future relative growth, decline, share, size, and value of any market sector and its players—up to four years in advance.

cards.title: No AI extrapolation
cards.text: We never guess. Statistical models hallucinate. A signed contract does not. Our terminal shows you only what governments and public bodies have already committed to buy.

cards.title: Contracts stay valid
cards.text: A procurement award notice remains actionable for up to four years after publication. We track every amendment, every euro, until the work is done.

cards.title: Accurate future value
cards.text: You see the exact value, the exact buyer, the exact supplier, and the exact timeframe. This is not a sentiment indicator. It is a ledger of future economic activity. Patent filed with INPI, ref. DSO2023020065.

why.imageAlt: Datixxia™ dashboard: contract award counts, plan and fact values by year and by country

about.label: About
about.title: Facts for futures™
about.text: The world's governments publish over eight million contract award notices every year. Each one is a data point containing a buyer, a supplier, a value, and a duration. Most platforms treat this as archival information. We treat it as a live signal. Datixxia™ ingests this firehose of structured data, normalizes it across 194 countries, and surfaces the real economy in motion. No sentiment analysis. No large language models. Just the hard arithmetic of public spending, updated daily.

model.label: Model
model.title: Datixxia™ Forecasting Model
model.lead: Public tenders fund a nation's priorities — and set off a chain reaction. One prime contract cascades into subcontracts, supply orders and services that ripple through SMEs and MSMEs for years. Datixxia™ reads these cascades daily across 194 countries and converts them into sector-level outlooks for key market players — with pragmatic precision, anchored to the source document.

benefits.label: Benefits
benefits.lead: Datixxia™ applies proprietary calculations to daily public and private procurement sources to deliver sector- and player-level market intelligence at scale with consistent, verifiable 4-year forecasts.

members.name: Malcolm Duff
members.bio:
Formerly the CEO of two ISO-9001 certified translation companies and senior translator in technology for UNESCO, Paris, Malcolm carried out the 2 years of groundbreaking conceptual and research work that resulted in Datixxia™.
He has extensive experience in managing multinational projects, notably with translators from 33 countries for the Inttranet™, the world's first multilingual portal (added to the UNESCO Observatory for the Information Society in January 2006). That and his in-depth knowledge of the Datixxia™ application make him the ideal Chief Executive Officer for its global deployment.

members.name: Yana Levchenko
members.bio: The founder of her own web design company only one year after escaping from the war in Ukraine with her children and pets, Yana has extensive experience in cyber-security and computing, backed by the wide-ranging skills in web design for a fast-growing customer base. She also brings to the team her eye for detail and aesthetic sense of beauty as a professional photographer published in magazines worldwide.

faq.lead: Direct answers to the questions we hear most often from the terminal floor.
